notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before saving and after a duplicate save attempt, but description is never editable.
REF-BM-04: Only the title can be updated; URL, description, tags, and note cannot be edited.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but bookmarks have no searchable note field.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators, parentheses, and literal-operator quoting are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action interface.
REF-BM-21: Actions cannot target the whole currently filtered collection.
REF-BM-22: Bookmarks are hard-coded to newest-first order; no sort-key selection is available.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and Markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: There is no archive state distinct from deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
